messages:
marta_cs: quick weekly check-in for LumenLake re: caching + batching — dropping this in for visibility. TL;DR: cache hit-rate 42% (-3ppt wk), avg batch size 6.8 (stable), cost per 1k tokens $1.45 (up 8%), p95 latency 220ms, error rate 0.9% (spike last night). thinking: enable prefix caching for 'search_prompt' queries + try a slightly larger batching window for read-heavy routes. @drew_se @ashley_eng any concerns?

drew_se: thanks. taking a look now. do we have breakdown by route? especially for the small write path that shouldn't be batched.

marta_cs: yes — sent export to the shared folder: /cs/accounts/lumenlake/2026-03-17-cache-export.csv. quick highlights: 75% of tokens come from 'search_prompt' and 'summary_read', 'write_note' is ~4% of volume but has lower batchability.

ashley_eng: quick read — i see the hit-rate drop aligns with the model change on 3/12 (quantization switch). KV cache invalidations increased after that. we can try: 1) enable prefix caching for 'search_prompt' (low risk), 2) increase batching window from 20ms -> 40ms for read routes (trade latency vs cost), 3) add a per-route cache TTL override to avoid noisy invalidation.

kevin_csm: customer feedback: LumenLake onboarding team is good but they've called out inconsistent latency during peak hours. renewal is still on track but they're flagging cost concerns. if we cut cost by 15% without impacting p50 (<120ms) they'll be happy.

ashley_eng: noted. plan i propose: A/B rollout for prefix caching on 'search_prompt' (50% traffic) + conservative batch window increase (30% of read traffic). monitor: cache hit-rate, p50/p95, errors, and cost/1k. if p95 jitter > 50ms we rollback.

opsbot: deploybot: Started canary rollout job id=canary-2775 for config changes (prefix_cache=on, batch_window_ms=40) at 2026-03-17T10:05Z.

drew_se: can you paste the config snippet we'll use? makes it easier to review.

ashley_eng: sure — config we plan to push to canary: ```yaml
routes:
  - name: search_prompt
    caching:
      prefix_cache: true
      ttl_ms: 3600000
  - name: summary_read
    batching:
      window_ms: 40
      max_batch_size: 64
defaults:
  cost_reporting: enabled
```

marta_cs: looks good. what are expected delta numbers if this works?

ashley_eng: conservative estimate: +15-18ppt hit-rate on search_prompt, avg batch size up ~0.8 tokens, overall cost per 1k down 10-18% depending on traffic shape. latency: p50 should be ~100-110ms, p95 might improve or stay ~220ms — we'll watch.

kevin_csm: i'll update the customer with these expected savings and the canary schedule. can we get a short one-pager (bullet list) i can share?

marta_cs: will draft a 1-pg summary after canary metrics come back. owners: Ashley (eng) for rollout, Drew (se) for monitoring and alerts, Marta/KEVIN for customer comms. follow-up sync next Tue. :thumbsup:

opsbot: deploybot: Canary job id=canary-2775 completed on 2026-03-17T10:20Z — 50% traffic applied to changes. Metrics stream enabled: /dashboards/lumenlake/canary-2775

drew_se: initial canary: cache hit-rate on search_prompt went 38% -> 61% for canary cohort, p50 improved ~12ms, p95 unchanged so far, error rate flat. continuing to monitor for 60m.

marta_cs: excellent. leaving action item: if canary holds for 60m with no p95 regression and errors stable, schedule full rollout tomorrow 9am PST. i'll note in the renewal tracker that we're targeting ~15% cost reduction.

kevin_csm: thanks team — i'll ping LumenLake post-rollout with the one-pager and ask for a quick PRD sign-off to lock renewal terms.

ashley_eng: copying next steps into ticket INF-1421 and adding the rollback playbook.

marta_cs: perfect. closing the loop here — will report back after full rollout.
